+

+    var ref: CFTypeRef?
+    _ = AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(element, kAXTitleAttribute as CFString, &ref)
+    return axString(ref)

+
+func role(of element: AXUIElement) -> String {
+    var ref: CFTypeRef?
+    _ = AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue(element, kAXRoleAttribute as CFString, &ref)
+    return axString(ref)
+}
+
+let app = NSWorkspace.shared.runningApplications.first { $0.localizedName == "Simulator" }

+    print("Simulator app not found")
+    exit(1)
+}
+

+      let windows = windowsRef as? [AXUIElement] else {
+    print("Could not read windows")
+    exit(1)
+}
+
+var queue = windows
+var seen = Set<ObjectIdentifier>()
+while !queue.isEmpty {
+    let element = queue.removeFirst()
+    let oid = ObjectIdentifier(element)
+    if seen.contains(oid) { continue }
+    seen.insert(oid)
+
+    let t = title(of: element)

+    if r == "AXButton" && t == "Open" {

+        exit(err == .success ? 0 : 1)
+    }
+
+    queue.append(contentsOf: children(of: element))
+}
+
+print("Open button not found")
+exit(1)
